lines.text: Many learners say: My phone is discharged.
A phone with no power is dead.

data.why: A phone with no power is dead.

quiz.stem: My phone is ___. I need a charger.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “My phone is discharged”? 😅 Русское «разряжен» похоже на “discharged”, и слово переводят буквально, но про телефон по-английски говорят “dead.” Правильно: “My phone is dead.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “dead.” Телефон сел — dead. Скажи вслух: “My phone is dead, I need a charger.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: A phone with no power is “dead”: “My phone is dead.”
en.caption: Do you also say “My phone is discharged”? 😅 The Russian word looks like “discharged”, so people translate it directly, but for a phone English says “dead.” Correct: “My phone is dead.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
